environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 instance behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. No additional response header manipulation at the load balancer level. Service runs as a Docker container with uvicorn, exposed on port 8000. ALB forwards traffic on port 443 with TLS termination. No CloudFront distribution or edge functions in front of the ALB.

config.alb_config: default listener rules, no custom response headers
config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB in public, task in private subnet
